sentences.text: Author: Soumen Sen Bench: Soumen Sen 04.10.2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code  Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik  Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection with Burtolla Police Station Case No.
 112 of 2024 dated 15.07.2024 corresponding to G.R Case No. 692 of 2024  under Sections 498A/313/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
 In Re: Supratim Roy  Petitioner  Mr. Biswajit Manna For the Petitioner  Mr. Subrata Roy  Ms. Pritha Paul For the State  Mr. Sourav Chatterjee  Mr. Pramito Bandyopadhyay  Ms. Sayanti Poddar For the De-facto Complainant  1.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he has received instruction not to press this application.
2. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner stands dismissed as not pressed without granting liberty to the petitioner to file afresh on the self-same cause of action.
3. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J) (Uday Kumar, J)
CRM (A)/3561/2024 on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68741399/
1
